answer: The summit receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 25 aliases trips the duplicate check at the ripple gate. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, so that the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. That is 12 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
